title: Turtle Taco Tempest
description: A giant sea turtle with a purple blanket covered in animal patterns swims through turbulent, colorful psychedelic waters. On its back sits a man in military uniform with a yellow parrot on his shoulder, while a black raven holds a paper note nearby. A bright pink taco food truck floats in the stormy sea beside them, with lightning, skulls, and a castle in the background. Tacos, limes, and a Fusion soda bottle appear in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal scene of a giant sea turtle swimming through swirling colorful waves, carrying a man in military uniform and peaked cap sitting on a purple blanket decorated with animal silhouettes. A yellow parrot perches on the man's shoulder and a black raven holds a note. A bright pink taco food truck with turtle patterns floats in the stormy sea. Dark cloudy sky with lightning bolts, floating skulls, and a distant black castle. Fresh tacos with purple cabbage, limes, and a Fusion soda bottle in the foreground. Psychedelic, detailed, vibrant colors.
